description_ru: Ханна хочет обменять куртку, которую подарила мама, но боится её обидеть, и тут мама появляется в том же магазине.
text:
Ravi: Good afternoon. Can I help you?
Hannah: I hope so. I'd like to change this jacket, please. Well, I'd like to change it, but I don't have the receipt.
Ravi: Hmm. Where did you buy it?
Hannah: I didn't. My mum bought it for my birthday. She says she got it here in March.
Ravi: Let me see. Yes, it's one of ours. Green, size twelve. Is there a problem with it?
Hannah: There's no problem with the jacket. It's a nice jacket. It's just not my size. Or my colour. Or my style, really.
Ravi: So, apart from the size, the colour and the style, it's perfect.
Hannah: Exactly.

Ravi: Don't worry, it happens all the time. Most people feel terrible about it.
Hannah: I do feel terrible. My mum was so happy when she gave it to me. She said, "Hannah, this is you!" And I said, "Thank you, Mum, I love it." That was a lie.
Ravi: A small lie. A kind lie.
Hannah: I've been saying the same lie for three months. Every time we meet, she asks, "Why aren't you wearing the jacket?" And I say, "It's too warm," or "It's in the wash."
Ravi: And what does she say?
Hannah: She says, "It's July, Hannah. Nothing is in the wash for three months."

Ravi: You know, if you don't have a receipt, I can't give you money back. But I can give you a gift card, or you can choose something else.
Hannah: A gift card is fine. Thank you. Can I look around first?
Ravi: Of course. What kind of thing are you looking for?
Hannah: Something blue. Or black. Something simple. I'd like to try that grey coat in the window, too.
Ravi: The long one? It's a beautiful coat, but it's a little expensive. Look at the price.
Hannah: Ouch.
Ravi: The jacket is worth sixty pounds. The coat is a hundred and twenty. You'd pay the difference.

Hannah: Hmm. That's a lot of money. Maybe the blue jumper is better.
Ravi: It's on sale this week. Thirty-five pounds.
Hannah: That's much better. Can I try it on?
Ravi: The changing rooms are over there. Take your time.
Hannah: Thanks. Oh, wait. Oh no.
Ravi: What's wrong?
Hannah: Don't look now, but my mum is coming through the door.

Ravi: Which one is she?
Hannah: The woman in the big red hat. With the umbrella.
Ravi: She's coming this way. Quick, hide the jacket.
Hannah: Where? Where do I hide it?
Ravi: Behind the desk. Under the box. Go, go, go!
Hannah: This is ridiculous. I'm thirty years old, and I'm hiding a jacket from my mother.
Ravi: It's my job to hide jackets from mothers. Smile. Be natural.

Mum: Hannah! What a surprise! What are you doing here?
Hannah: Hi, Mum. I'm just... looking. At jumpers. And you?
Mum: I'm returning a pair of gloves. They were a present for your father, but he says they're too tight. Young man, can you help me?
Ravi: Of course, madam. May I see the receipt?
Mum: I don't have the receipt. I lost it. Do you think that's a problem?
Ravi: Not at all. Not at all. We can find a solution.
Hannah: Mum, what a coincidence. We're both returning things.

Mum: Are you? What are you returning?
Hannah: Um. Nothing. I mean, it's just a thing. A small thing.
Mum: Hannah, is it the green jacket?
Hannah: Mum...
Mum: I'm not stupid, darling. I saw your face when you opened it. And you never wear it. Three months!
Hannah: I'm so sorry. I didn't want to hurt your feelings.
Mum: Hurt my feelings? I didn't want to buy it. The shop assistant told me that all young women love it. I wanted to buy you a book.

Hannah: A book?
Mum: There was a lovely book about birds. You like birds. But the assistant was so persuasive, and I was in such a hurry...
Ravi: I'm very sorry about that, madam. I wasn't working in March.
Mum: Don't worry, it's not your fault. It's mine. I should have listened to my heart.
Hannah: Mum, the jacket cost sixty pounds. Ravi can give me a gift card for it.
Mum: Then let's do this. You use the gift card and choose a nice jumper. And I'll buy you the bird book from the shop next door. That's your real present.
Hannah: But the jacket was my present.
Mum: The jacket was a mistake. And your father's gloves were a mistake too. We're a family of mistakes. Come on.

Ravi: If you like, I can give you a small discount on the gloves. A bigger pair is only twelve pounds.
Mum: That's a very generous offer, young man. One large pair, please.
Hannah: And one blue jumper. In a size ten, this time.
Ravi: Coming right up. And thank you both for being so honest.
Mum: Honest? Hannah lied to me for three months.
Hannah: And you let me.
Mum: Of course I did. I wanted to see how long it takes.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Короткий звук между «а» и «э», рот полуоткрыт; не произносите «о».
Кончик языка не касается нёба и не вибрирует; не раскатывайте русское «р».
Верхние зубы касаются нижней губы, звук звонкий; не заменяйте на «ф» или «в» без зубов.
Начните с «а» и плавно перейдите в «и»; не разделяйте на два звука.

Why does she not have a receipt?
